g.text: More pupils do not create more randomized schools.
2,000 simulated trials per scenario. Error bars: 95% Wilson Monte Carlo intervals.
Balanced school assignment, equal cluster sizes, Gaussian outcomes. Dashed line: nominal 5% false-positive rate.
